headword: コストパフォーマンス
reading: こすとぱふぉーまんす

definitions.explanation: The ratio of what you get to what you pay. Used positively (good value) or negatively (poor value), and applied to products, services, or experiences. Commonly abbreviated as コスパ.

examples.japanese: この{店|みせ}はコストパフォーマンスがいい。
examples.english: This shop has good value for money.

examples.japanese: {値段|ねだん}のわりにコストパフォーマンスが{悪|わる}い。
examples.english: The value for money is poor relative to the price.

examples.japanese: コストパフォーマンスを{重視|じゅうし}して{家電|かでん}を{選|えら}んでいる。
examples.english: I choose home appliances with an emphasis on cost-performance.

notes:
Loanword from English. In conversation, the clipped form コスパ is far more common; the full form appears in writing and formal speech.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- コストパフォーマンスがいい / {高|たか}い: good cost-performance
- コストパフォーマンスが{悪|わる}い: poor cost-performance
- コストパフォーマンスを{重視|じゅうし}する: to prioritize value for money

SIMILAR WORDS:
- コスパ: clipped colloquial form — much more common in speech
- {割|わり}に{合|あ}う: to be worth it — verb-phrase synonym
